marketing / Lifecycle

Klaviyo

Make lifecycle marketing respond to customer behavior.

KOfficial product ↗Open in the hierarchy →
Level 4Inspect the detail

Klaviyo connects customer profiles, behavioral events, segmentation, and lifecycle messaging. MoreSpace can build acquisition-to-retention journeys that respond to meaningful customer actions, coordinate approved communication, and report the relationship between campaigns and repeat customer value.

Useful outputs

  • Behavior-based segments and reviewed lifecycle journey rules
  • Customer messages linked to eligible events and audiences
  • Campaign and flow reports joined with customer value measures

Where we can apply it

  • Subscribed customer → welcome flow → engagement signal → next relevant message.
  • Purchase event → customer segment → reviewed repeat-order offer → retention view.
  • Inactive customer → eligibility review → win-back flow → customer outcome comparison.
01

Use case 1

Build welcome, browse, purchase, and win-back journeys for eligible customers.

02

Use case 2

Segment customer profiles using approved attributes and observed behavior.

03

Use case 3

Connect campaign and flow outcomes with repeat-purchase reporting.

Inputs we need

  • Customer profiles, subscription choices, and purchase history
  • Agreed behavioral events and customer lifecycle definitions
  • Approved offers, message templates, and frequency rules

Delivery sequence

  • Map customer moments to event definitions and eligible message audiences.
  • Validate profile and commerce events, then test journey conditions.
  • Run reviewed flows and compare engagement with longer-term customer outcomes.

Expert review points

  • Approve offers and contact frequency across overlapping customer journeys.
  • Review attribution assumptions before crediting campaigns with incremental revenue.

We confirm available integrations, plans, permissions, and data mapping before implementing these connection candidates.

  • E-commerce platforms
  • Customer databases
  • n8n
  • HTTP APIs

Signals we can make visible

  • Flow conversion rate
  • Revenue per recipient
  • Repeat purchase rate
  • Unsubscribe rate

We agree the source, population, period, denominator, and decision behind each measure.
